summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of HBOT clinic new features. Backend: 18/18 new tests pass (AI anamnesis_summary & soap_draft return status=ok with non-empty drafts and requires_clinician_verification=true for DOCTOR; NURSE & SECRETARY get 403; /ai/capabilities returns capabilities map; File upload supports both document and wound_photo kinds, download returns correct content-type bytes, unauthenticated download gets 401, listing by patient_id works; Patient portal /portal/me, /portal/anamnesis, /portal/appointments all return 200 for PATIENT; PATIENT gets 403 on /api/patients and /api/ai/*; portal anamnesis submission works; staff get 403 on /portal/*; appointment create and list verified) + 31/31 regression tests from backend_test.py still pass. Frontend: doctor login OK, Appointments page shows daily header with prev/next/today buttons (appt-prev-day, appt-next-day, appt-today) and renders empty state correctly for days without appointments; patient detail page shows all expected tabs including tab-documents, tab-appointments, tab-wounds, tab-anamnesis, tab-timeline; AI Anamnez Özeti and AI SOAP Taslağı buttons open a dialog with disclaimer, live-generated GPT 6 Luna Turkish draft, and 'Onayla & Not Olarak Kaydet' save button; upload-document and upload-wound-photo buttons present; portal-access-btn present. Patient portal (hasta1@demo.com) logs in and redirects to /portal with name, patient_number, 'Anamnez Formunu Doldur' button, submitted forms list, and appointments list; attempting to navigate to /patients as PATIENT redirects back to /portal (correct RBAC guard). Overall 49/49 backend + full frontend flows green.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.py returns status=error with the raw exception message on LLM failure (good) but the client-side AISummaryButton should surface this as a toast (currently alerts could be improved).

files.py download allows ?auth= query token which bypasses httpOnly cookies and makes the token appear in server access logs/referrer. Acceptable for workaround, but prefer short-lived signed URLs long-term.
portal.py submit stores arbitrary body fields with no Pydantic schema — same pattern as other MVP endpoints; low risk but worth tightening.
patients.py portal-access rejects duplicate email with 400 — fine, but does not allow a staff member to RESET a patient's portal password; add an endpoint if needed.
server.py app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware) is called AFTER include_router. Starlette handles this but conventional order is middleware-first.
ai.py exposes /ai/capabilities to NURSE but POST /ai/{capability} only to DOCTOR/CLINIC_ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN — intentional, documented.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-2 flows (AI dialog, file upload buttons, appointments day view, patient portal redirect & RBAC)
